description: This Java source file defines the AssetController class, which handles REST API endpoints for managing assets in the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for CRUD operations, assignment to customers and edges, bulk import, and related asset queries.

classes.name: AssetController
classes.description: REST controller for managing assets, including CRUD operations, assignment, unassignment, bulk import, and related queries within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: getAssetById
methods.description: Fetches an Asset object by its ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: getAssetInfoById
methods.description: Fetches AssetInfo object by asset ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: saveAsset
methods.description: Creates or updates an asset, with conflict resolution strategies.

methods.name: deleteAsset
methods.description: Deletes an asset and its relations by ID.

methods.name: assignAssetToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns an asset to a customer.

methods.name: unassignAssetFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes asset assignment from a customer.

methods.name: assignAssetToPublicCustomer
methods.description: Makes an asset publicly accessible.

methods.name: getTenantAssets
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tenant-owned assets.

methods.name: getTenantAssetInfos
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of asset info objects for tenant.

methods.name: getTenantAsset
methods.description: Fetches a tenant asset by name.

methods.name: getTenantAssetByName
methods.description: Fetches a tenant asset by name (API endpoint).

methods.name: getCustomerAssets
methods.description: Retrieves assets assigned to a customer.

methods.name: getCustomerAssetInfos
methods.description: Retrieves asset info objects assigned to a customer.

methods.name: getAssetsByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple assets by their IDs, considering user permissions.

methods.name: findAssetsByQuery
methods.description: Finds assets related to a specific entity based on complex search query.

methods.name: getAssetTypes
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve asset types.

methods.name: assignAssetToEdge
methods.description: Assigns an asset to an edge.

methods.name: unassignAssetFromEdge
methods.description: Removes asset assignment from an edge.

methods.name: getEdgeAssets
methods.description: Retrieves assets assigned to an edge, with optional filtering.

methods.name: processAssetsBulkImport
methods.description: Handles bulk import of assets via CSV file.
